\begin{example} \end{example}[Quotient by a subspace contractible in $X$] ↗ ex:quotient-contractible-subcomplex-mapping-cone ↗ def:suspension 1. ch0:0.14\group Homotopy Theory

If $(X,A)$ is a CW pair and $A\hookrightarrow X$ is homotopic to a constant map, then $X/A\simeq X\vee SA$. In particular, $S^n/S^i\simeq S^n\vee S^{i+1}$ for $i<n$. \end{example}
